about: WELLSTAR Technologies Corp. operates as a healthcare technology company in Canada. The company offers electronic medical records software for primary care and specialist providers, AI-enabled digital health applications, patient engagement and eReferral solutions, billing and back-office services, and IT and practice management services; and digital health networks services. It also provides Nexus AI, which provides agentic AI solutions that automate complex healthcare workflows, and reducing cognitive load while improving patient care outcomes. It serves primary care physicians, specialists, health systems, and public sector organizations. WELLSTAR Technologies Corp. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Vancouver, Canada. WELLSTAR Technologies Corp. operates as a subsidiary of WELL Health Technologies Corp.
